content: Melvin-Koushki notes that Akhlāṭī sent Ibn Turka a letter urging his accomplished disciple to write a work establishing the propositions (muqaddamāt) and conjunctions (iqtirānāt) proper to the science of letters, and says the Mafāḥiṣ is Ibn Turka's answer to this call.
refers_to_primary: Sayyid Ḥusayn Akhlāṭī, letter to Ibn Turka (Munshaʾāt)
